WITH latest_risk_ranked AS ( SELECT ra.risk_assessment_id, ra.inventory_balance_id, ra.forecast_id, ra.risk_grade, ra.shortage_yn, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ra.inventory_balance_id ORDER BY ra.updated_at DESC, ra.risk_assessment_id DESC ) AS row_no FROM risk_assessment ra WHERE ra.is_deleted = 0 ), latest_risk AS ( SELECT risk_assessment_id, inventory_balance_id, forecast_id, risk_grade, shortage_yn FROM latest_risk_ranked WHERE row_no = 1 ), latest_forecast_ranked AS ( SELECT df.forecast_id, df.sku_id, df.sales_point_id, df.predicted_qty_d7, df.predicted_qty_d14, df.predicted_qty_d30, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY df.sku_id, df.sales_point_id ORDER BY df.base_date DESC, df.updated_at DESC, df.forecast_id DESC ) AS row_no FROM demand_forecast df JOIN ml_model_version mv ON mv.model_version_id = df.model_version_id AND mv.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mv.is_deleted = 0 WHERE df.is_deleted = 0 AND df.base_date <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) AND df.forecast_source <> 'DUMMY_BASELINE' ), latest_forecast AS ( SELECT forecast_id, sku_id, sales_point_id, predicted_qty_d7, predicted_qty_d14, predicted_qty_d30 FROM latest_forecast_ranked WHERE row_no = 1 ), latest_cost_ranked AS ( SELECT sc.sku_id, sc.unit_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY sc.sku_id ORDER BY sc.effective_from DESC, sc.updated_at DESC, sc.sku_cost_id DESC ) AS row_no FROM sku_cost sc WHERE sc.is_deleted = 0 AND sc.effective_from <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) AND (sc.effective_to IS NULL OR sc.effective_to >= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE))) ), latest_cost AS ( SELECT sku_id, unit_cost FROM latest_cost_ranked WHERE row_no = 1 ), inventory_base AS ( SELECT ib.inventory_balance_id, ib.sku_id, ib.warehouse_id, ib.stock_sales_point_id, COALESCE(ib.allocated_sales_point_id, ib.stock_sales_point_id) AS demand_sales_point_id, w.warehouse_code, w.warehouse_name, w.region_code AS warehouse_region_code, demand_sp.sales_point_code AS demand_sales_point_code, demand_sp.sales_point_name AS demand_sales_point_name, demand_sp.region_code AS demand_sales_point_region_code, demand_ch.channel_type AS demand_channel_type, COALESCE(l.sale_stop_date, l.expiry_date) AS effective_sale_stop_date, ib.on_hand_qty, ib.total_qty AS current_qty, CASE WHEN l.lot_status = 'AVAILABLE' AND COALESCE(l.sale_stop_date, l.expiry_date) IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) < TRUNC(COALESCE(l.sale_stop_date, l.expiry_date)) THEN ib.on_hand_qty ELSE 0 END AS available_qty, lr.risk_assessment_id, lr.risk_grade, lr.shortage_yn, COALESCE(linked_df.forecast_id, fallback_df.forecast_id) AS selected_forecast_id, COALESCE(linked_df.predicted_qty_d7, fallback_df.predicted_qty_d7) AS predicted_qty_d7, COALESCE(linked_df.predicted_qty_d14, fallback_df.predicted_qty_d14) AS predicted_qty_d14, COALESCE(linked_df.predicted_qty_d30, fallback_df.predicted_qty_d30) AS predicted_qty_d30, lc.unit_cost FROM inventory_balance ib JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND s.active_yn = 'Y' AND s.is_deleted = 0 JOIN product p ON p.product_id = s.product_id AND p.product_status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lot l ON l.lot_id = ib.lot_id AND l.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = ib.warehouse_id AND w.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_point stock_sp ON stock_sp.sales_point_id = ib.stock_sales_point_id AND stock_sp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_channel stock_ch ON stock_ch.sales_channel_id = stock_sp.sales_channel_id AND stock_ch.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_point demand_sp ON demand_sp.sales_point_id = COALESCE(ib.allocated_sales_point_id, ib.stock_sales_point_id) AND demand_sp.active_yn = 'Y' AND demand_sp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_channel demand_ch ON demand_ch.sales_channel_id = demand_sp.sales_channel_id AND demand_ch.active_yn = 'Y' AND demand_ch.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN latest_risk lr ON lr.inventory_balance_id = ib.inventory_balance_id LEFT JOIN demand_forecast linked_df ON linked_df.forecast_id = lr.forecast_id AND linked_df.is_deleted = 0 AND linked_df.base_date <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) AND linked_df.forecast_source <> 'DUMMY_BASELINE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ml_model_version linked_mv WHERE linked_mv.model_version_id = linked_df.model_version_id AND linked_mv.status = 'ACTIVE' AND linked_mv.is_deleted = 0 ) LEFT JOIN latest_forecast fallback_df ON fallback_df.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND fallback_df.sales_point_id = COALESCE(ib.allocated_sales_point_id, ib.stock_sales_point_id) LEFT JOIN latest_cost lc ON lc.sku_id = ib.sku_id WHERE ib.is_deleted = 0 AND ( ib.lot_id IS NULL OR (l.lot_id IS NOT NULL AND l.lot_status <> 'DEPLETED') ) AND ( (ib.stock_sales_point_id IS NOT NULL AND stock_sp.active_yn = 'Y' AND stock_ch.active_yn = 'Y') OR (ib.stock_sales_point_id IS NULL AND ib.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL AND w.active_yn = 'Y') ) ), scope_inventory AS ( SELECT 'NATIONAL' AS scope_type, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS scope_warehouse_id, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS scope_sales_point_id, 'ALL' AS scope_code, '전국' AS scope_name, '전국' AS scope_region_code, ib.* FROM inventory_base ib
UNION ALL
SELECT 'WAREHOUSE', CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), 'ALL', '전체 물류센터', '전국', ib.* FROM inventory_base ib WHERE ib.stock_sales_point_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'WAREHOUSE', ib.warehouse_id, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), ib.warehouse_code, ib.warehouse_name, ib.warehouse_region_code, ib.* FROM inventory_base ib WHERE ib.stock_sales_point_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT CASE ib.demand_channel_type WHEN 'OFFLINE' THEN 'OFFLINE_STORE' ELSE 'ONLINE_STORE' END, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), 'ALL', CASE ib.demand_channel_type WHEN 'OFFLINE' THEN '전체 오프라인 매장' ELSE '전체 온라인 판매처' END, CASE ib.demand_channel_type WHEN 'OFFLINE' THEN '전국' ELSE '온라인' END, ib.* FROM inventory_base ib WHERE ib.demand_sales_point_id IS NOT NULL AND ib.demand_channel_type IN ('OFFLINE', 'ONLINE')
UNION ALL
SELECT CASE ib.demand_channel_type WHEN 'OFFLINE' THEN 'OFFLINE_STORE' ELSE 'ONLINE_STORE' END, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), ib.demand_sales_point_id, ib.demand_sales_point_code, ib.demand_sales_point_name, ib.demand_sales_point_region_code, ib.* FROM inventory_base ib WHERE ib.demand_sales_point_id IS NOT NULL AND ib.demand_channel_type IN ('OFFLINE', 'ONLINE')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'UNASSIGNED', CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), 'UNASSIGNED', '공용 미할당', '전국 물류센터', ib.* FROM inventory_base ib WHERE ib.demand_sales_point_id IS NULL ), scope_definitions AS ( SELECT 'NATIONAL' AS scope_type, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS warehouse_id, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS sales_point_id, 'ALL' AS scope_code, '전국' AS scope_name, '전국' AS region_code FROM dual
UNION ALL
SELECT 'WAREHOUSE', CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), 'ALL', '전체 물류센터', '전국' FROM dual
UNION ALL
SELECT 'WAREHOUSE', w.warehouse_id, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), w.warehouse_code, w.warehouse_name, w.region_code FROM warehouse w WHERE w.active_yn = 'Y' AND w.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'OFFLINE_STORE', CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), 'ALL', '전체 오프라인 매장', '전국' FROM dual
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ONLINE_STORE', CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), 'ALL', '전체 온라인 판매처', '온라인' FROM dual
UNION ALL
SELECT CASE sc.channel_type WHEN 'OFFLINE' THEN 'OFFLINE_STORE' ELSE 'ONLINE_STORE' END, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), sp.sales_point_id, sp.sales_point_code, sp.sales_point_name, sp.region_code FROM sales_point sp JOIN sales_channel sc ON sc.sales_channel_id = sp.sales_channel_id AND sc.channel_type IN ('OFFLINE', 'ONLINE') AND sc.active_yn = 'Y' AND sc.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sp.active_yn = 'Y' AND sp.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'UNASSIGNED', CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), CAST(NULL AS NUMBER), 'UNASSIGNED', '공용 미할당', '전국 물류센터' FROM dual ), scope_sku_risk AS ( SELECT scope_type, scope_code, sku_id, MAX( CASE risk_grade WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 4 WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 3 WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 2 WHEN 'GOOD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS risk_severity FROM scope_inventory WHERE current_qty > 0 GROUP BY scope_type, scope_code, sku_id ), scope_risk_counts AS ( SELECT scope_type, scope_code, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_severity = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical_sku_count, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_severity = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warning_sku_count, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_severity = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normal_sku_count, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_severity = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS good_sku_count, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_severity = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unassessed_sku_count FROM scope_sku_risk GROUP BY scope_type, scope_code ), scope_summary AS ( SELECT scope_type, scope_warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, scope_sales_point_id AS sales_point_id, scope_code, scope_name, scope_region_code AS region_code, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN current_qty > 0 THEN sku_id END) AS total_sku_count, SUM(current_qty) AS total_stock_qty, SUM(available_qty) AS available_stock_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_grade = 'CRITICAL' THEN current_qty ELSE 0 END) AS critical_stock_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_grade = 'WARNING' THEN current_qty ELSE 0 END) AS warning_stock_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_grade = 'NORMAL' THEN current_qty ELSE 0 END) AS normal_stock_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_grade = 'GOOD' THEN current_qty ELSE 0 END) AS good_stock_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_grade IS NULL THEN current_qty ELSE 0 END) AS unassessed_stock_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN shortage_yn = 'Y' THEN sku_id END) AS shortage_sku_count, SUM(CASE WHEN unit_cost IS NOT NULL THEN current_qty * unit_cost ELSE 0 END) AS total_inventory_cost_amount, SUM( CASE WHEN risk_grade = 'CRITICAL' AND unit_cost IS NOT NULL THEN current_qty * unit_cost ELSE 0 END ) AS critical_inventory_cost_amount, COUNT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN current_qty > 0 AND unit_cost IS NULL THEN sku_id END ) AS missing_cost_sku_count, SUM(CASE WHEN unit_cost IS NULL THEN current_qty ELSE 0 END) AS missing_cost_stock_qty, COUNT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN current_qty > 0 AND risk_assessment_id IS NULL THEN sku_id END ) AS unassessed_quality_sku_count FROM scope_inventory GROUP BY scope_type, scope_warehouse_id, scope_sales_point_id, scope_code, scope_name, scope_region_code ), scope_disposal_groups AS ( SELECT scope_type, scope_code, sku_id, demand_sales_point_id, selected_forecast_id, SUM( CASE WHEN effective_sale_stop_date > TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) AND effective_sale_stop_date <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) + 7 THEN available_qty ELSE 0 END ) AS expiring_qty_d7, SUM( CASE WHEN effective_sale_stop_date > TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) AND effective_sale_stop_date <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) + 14 THEN available_qty ELSE 0 END ) AS expiring_qty_d14, SUM( CASE WHEN effective_sale_stop_date > TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) AND effective_sale_stop_date <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) + 30 THEN available_qty ELSE 0 END ) AS expiring_qty_d30, MAX(predicted_qty_d7) AS predicted_qty_d7, MAX(predicted_qty_d14) AS predicted_qty_d14, MAX(predicted_qty_d30) AS predicted_qty_d30, MAX(unit_cost) AS unit_cost FROM scope_inventory WHERE selected_forecast_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY scope_type, scope_code, sku_id, demand_sales_point_id, selected_forecast_id ), scope_expected_disposal AS ( SELECT scope_type, scope_code, sku_id, GREATEST( 0, expiring_qty_d7 - predicted_qty_d7, expiring_qty_d14 - predicted_qty_d14, expiring_qty_d30 - predicted_qty_d30 ) AS expected_disposal_qty, unit_cost FROM scope_disposal_groups ), scope_disposal_summary AS ( SELECT scope_type, scope_code, SUM(expected_disposal_qty) AS expected_disposal_qty_30d, SUM( CASE WHEN unit_cost IS NOT NULL THEN expected_disposal_qty * unit_cost ELSE 0 END ) AS expected_disposal_loss_amount_30d FROM scope_expected_disposal GROUP BY scope_type, scope_code ), scope_missing_forecast AS ( SELECT scope_type, scope_code, COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id) AS missing_forecast_sku_count, SUM(available_qty) AS missing_forecast_stock_qty FROM scope_inventory WHERE selected_forecast_id IS NULL AND available_qty > 0 AND effective_sale_stop_date > TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) AND effective_sale_stop_date <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE)) + 30 GROUP BY scope_type, scope_code ) SELECT definition.scope_type, definition.warehouse_id, definition.sales_point_id, definition.scope_code, definition.scope_name, definition.region_code, COALESCE(summary.total_sku_count, 0) AS total_sku_count, COALESCE(summary.total_stock_qty, 0) AS total_stock_qty, COALESCE(summary.available_stock_qty, 0) AS available_stock_qty, COALESCE(risk.critical_sku_count, 0) AS critical_sku_count, COALESCE(risk.warning_sku_count, 0) AS warning_sku_count, COALESCE(risk.normal_sku_count, 0) AS normal_sku_count, COALESCE(risk.good_sku_count, 0) AS good_sku_count, COALESCE(risk.unassessed_sku_count, 0) AS unassessed_distribution_sku_count, COALESCE(summary.critical_stock_qty, 0) AS critical_stock_qty, COALESCE(summary.warning_stock_qty, 0) AS warning_stock_qty, COALESCE(summary.normal_stock_qty, 0) AS normal_stock_qty, COALESCE(summary.good_stock_qty, 0) AS good_stock_qty, COALESCE(summary.unassessed_stock_qty, 0) AS unassessed_distribution_stock_qty, COALESCE(summary.shortage_sku_count, 0) AS shortage_sku_count, COALESCE(disposal.expected_disposal_qty_30d, 0) AS expected_disposal_qty_30d, COALESCE(summary.total_inventory_cost_amount, 0) AS total_inventory_cost_amount, COALESCE(summary.critical_inventory_cost_amount, 0) AS critical_inventory_cost_amount, COALESCE(disposal.expected_disposal_loss_amount_30d, 0) AS expected_disposal_loss_amount_30d, COALESCE(summary.missing_cost_sku_count, 0) AS missing_cost_sku_count, COALESCE(summary.missing_cost_stock_qty, 0) AS missing_cost_stock_qty, COALESCE(summary.unassessed_quality_sku_count, 0) AS unassessed_sku_count, COALESCE(summary.unassessed_stock_qty, 0) AS unassessed_stock_qty, COALESCE(forecast.missing_forecast_sku_count, 0) AS missing_forecast_sku_count, COALESCE(forecast.missing_forecast_stock_qty, 0) AS missing_forecast_stock_qty FROM scope_definitions definition LEFT JOIN scope_summary summary ON summary.scope_type = definition.scope_type AND summary.scope_code = definition.scope_code LEFT JOIN scope_risk_counts risk ON risk.scope_type = definition.scope_type AND risk.scope_code = definition.scope_code LEFT JOIN scope_disposal_summary disposal ON disposal.scope_type = definition.scope_type AND disposal.scope_code = definition.scope_code LEFT JOIN scope_missing_forecast forecast ON forecast.scope_type = definition.scope_type AND forecast.scope_code = definition.scope_code ORDER BY CASE definition.scope_type WHEN 'NATIONAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'WAREHOUSE' THEN 2 WHEN 'OFFLINE_STORE' THEN 3 WHEN 'ONLINE_STORE' THEN 4 WHEN 'UNASSIGNED' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, CASE WHEN definition.scope_code = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, definition.scope_name
